title: Florida House, District 91
what_it_does: Represents District 91 (Part of Palm Beach) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.

candidates.name: Peggy Gossett-Seidman
candidates.occupation: Former sportswriter and media/public relations director; state representative since 2022
candidates.background: Peggy Gossett-Seidman was born in Topeka, Kansas, earned a degree in English, journalism and history from Michigan State University, and worked as a sportswriter and media and public relations director. She lives in Highland Beach and has represented District 91 (Boca Raton area) since 2022, winning re-election in 2024.

candidates.name: Luis Garcia
candidates.occupation: Retired Boca Raton firefighter/paramedic; licensed claims adjuster; U.S. Marine Corps veteran
candidates.background: Luis Garcia, 59, served 28 years with the Boca Raton Fire Department as a firefighter and paramedic and has 14 years of experience as a licensed claims adjuster. Born in Colombia, he became a U.S. citizen after serving in the Marine Corps, and he runs a nonprofit focused on reducing opioid deaths. He is a father of two adult sons.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

immigration.summary: In a candidate interview with Indivisible Boca Raton, Garcia said the Legislature should reverse the state mandate that requires local law enforcement to help enforce federal immigration law under 287(g) agreements. He has also founded an ICE Watch legal observer team in South Florida.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91

abortion.summary: Supports abortion access with no restrictions and calls the end of Roe v. Wade a regression.
abortion.quote: ALWAYS. NO restriction,whatsoever. Roe Vs Wade was law for 50 years and this backwards regression is unacceptable.

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters), State Representative 91: Luis Garcia responses

housing.summary: Supports more rent subsidies for low-income workers and restricting large investors from buying homes.
housing.quote: WE MUST offer additional subsidies to assisting working poor people to pay rent. FL must restrict Big Investors buying up real estate which prevents true resident home ownership..

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters), State Representative 91: Luis Garcia responses

healthcare.summary: Calls for restoring Medicaid funding for all Floridians and funding the PACE program for seniors, and says the money should come from elsewhere in the state budget.
healthcare.quote: Reinstating Medicaid funding for ALL floridians and also PACE which specifically helps frail seniors stay at home instead of nursing homes

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters), State Representative 91: Luis Garcia responses

elections.summary: Calls a proof-of-citizenship requirement an unnecessary voting impediment and says his office would help people obtain documents.
elections.quote: If that unneccessary voter impediment becomes law, I would offer & promote services at my District 91 office in Boca Raton to assist affected persons in anyway possible to obtain required documents.

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters), State Representative 91: Luis Garcia responses

insurance.summary: Says fraud and overbilling, not insurer greed, are the main cause of high premiums, and proposes laws against kickbacks and licensing for restoration-company salespeople rather than rate controls.
insurance.quote: Florida is number one in the USA for property insurance fraud & overbilling. THAT is the main problem!

sources.title: VOTE411 Voter Guide (League of Women Voters), State Representative 91: Luis Garcia responses

other_issues.title: Insurance and condo costs
other_issues.summary: Drawing on his claims-adjuster background, he calls for reforming Citizens Property Insurance and cracking down on property and casualty insurance fraud, and describes condo assessments as a cost-of-living emergency.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91 - Indivisible Boca Raton Media

other_issues.title: Seniors and security
other_issues.summary: He calls for restoring federal Meals on Wheels funding, repurposing the Florida State Guard to protect houses of worship, and creating an elder-fraud task force.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91 - Indivisible Boca Raton Media

other_issues.title: Property insurance and claims
other_issues.summary: Drawing on 14 years as a licensed claims adjuster, Garcia said he would focus on reforming Citizens Property Insurance and on property and casualty insurance fraud, which he described as widespread in Florida.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91

other_issues.title: Condominium assessments
other_issues.summary: Garcia described rising condominium assessments in the district as a cost-of-living emergency for working and middle-class residents.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91

other_issues.title: Elder fraud
other_issues.summary: Garcia proposed converting the 33 sworn officers of Florida's Division of Election Security into an elder fraud task force aimed at protecting the district's older residents. He also called for the state to restore funding for Meals on Wheels after federal cuts.

sources.title: (Video) Luis Garcia - Florida House Candidate for District 91
